agent_notes: Government directory verification succeeded: the exact NIRF 2025 CollegeRankingALL row lists AMBAH PG COLLEGE , AMBAH in Morena, Madhya Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification for www.nirfindia.org failed with curl error 60 (self signed certificate in certificate chain); after confirming the expected NIRF hostname, curl --insecure was used only for the public GET. The official college site ambahpgcollege.org fetched successfully with normal TLS.

The official programme pages explicitly catalogue B.A.(Bachelor of Arts), B.Sc.(Mathematics Group), B.Sc.(Bio. Group), B.Com.(Bachelor of Commerce), M.A. (Hindi), M.A. (Geography), M.A. (Economics), M.Sc. (Chemistry), M.Sc. (Mathematics), M.Sc. (Zoology), and P.G.D.C.A.; durations are not stated and are null.

The official footer/download pages mention Diploma and Ph.D, but their official pages expose only question-paper download interfaces (including 2020-21 sessions) and do not establish a current diploma or doctoral catalogue. Certificate courses appear only in official news/notice items, which are excluded as short-term or expired events. The course catalogue is therefore partial and the record is manual_review.

Subject combinations are represented through the official B.A. programme and B.Sc. group programme names without inventing extra specialization labels; career mappings cover the disciplines explicitly listed on those official pages.
